questions.question: What is the time complexity of startsWith(prefix) in a trie holding N words?
options: O(L), where L is the prefix length
questions.explanation: A trie walks one node per character of the prefix, independent of how many words are stored.

questions.question: What is the KMP prefix-function (lps) array for "ababaca"?
questions.explanation: lps[i] is the length of the longest proper prefix of p[0..i] that is also a suffix; "ababa" gives 3 and "ababac" gives 0.

questions.question: In KMP, why is j set to lps[j - 1] rather than 0 after a full match?
options: So that overlapping matches are still found
It makes no difference to the result
questions.explanation: Keeping the matched suffix that is also a prefix means a match overlapping the previous one, like "abab" at 0 and 2 in "abababcabab", is not missed.

questions.question: Why must Rabin-Karp verify the characters when two hashes match?
options: Hashes are only computed for the first window
Different strings can share the same hash value (a collision)
Verification is needed to compute the next window hash
questions.explanation: A modular hash maps many strings to the same value, so equal hashes only indicate a candidate; verification avoids false positives.
